ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Ведомости сдачи партионной почты (формы 5 и 6)
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.outgoing_number AS out_num, m.russian_post_id AS barcode, m.to_zip AS recipient_zip, c.name AS recipient_name, m.weight AS item_weight, m.fee AS item_fee, m.declared_value AS item_value FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE m.id IN (:SelectedMailIds) ORDER BY m.id ASC;
